name: jobicy-jobs-mcp
description: Jobicy (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyless ('No API key … No account or authentication header is required'). location must be a Jobicy location slug (?get=locations lists them); there is no page parameter — count is the whole result set, so page > 1 repeats it. Jobicy asks that stored listings be re-checked only 'once or twice per hour'. An official MCP server also exists at https://jobicy.com/mcp.
